selection_declaration.public_interest_question: Can a reader distinguish a dense, receipted roster as structural context from a hop-eligible bounded shared surface?
selection_declaration.selection_unit: A checked-in ledger surface whose surface_type is directory_roster_surface and whose hop_eligible value is false.
selection_declaration.universe: All current data/ledger/surfaces.jsonl rows matching that selection unit at the route snapshot.
selection_declaration.selection_rule: Use the single universe row whose hop_refusal_reason is dense_directory_listing_not_shared_participation. At this snapshot, the universe contains 36 rows and that rule selects dialog-public-directory-exposure-2026-06-16, the dated successor to the retired dialog-society-membership composite. The other 35 rows are refused for different reasons: 20 portfolio pages and programme rosters under dense_roster_density_policy (Capital Factory, Stratos Ventures, eleven fund portfolio pages, the 2022, 2024 and 2025 a16z American Dynamism rosters, the 2023 to 2025 Reagan National Defense Forum rosters and the UK AI Safety Summit 2023 attendee roster), four organization-only ranked lists and one list methodology exit, two organization-only shortlists, one organization-only portfolio listing (Shield Capital), organization-only and single-actor roundtables, organization-only programme context, an invitation without attendance, two reported Capital Factory Fed Supernova rosters without an upgrade disposition, and one single-actor Fed Supernova context row.
selection_declaration.sunset_condition: Replace this route when the declared universe changes or when a public-facing route is separately authorized.
